name: LumenLab
promise: One exact idea from maths, space or chemistry, shown so clearly you can check it yourself.

audience.who: students and people who liked science at school

forbidden: clickbait that the video does not pay off

style.narration: none: on-screen text and music, as in the reference videos

signature.why: Things a copier has to rebuild rather than re-upload.
elements: Method card at the end of every video: what was computed, with what model, and what the result does not show.
Every chart is the computed curve, drawn live; a small tag names the lab script's method.
Series numbering in the step pill (for example 'Titration 2/5').
The wordmark gradient and the amber/teal/violet accent order.
A three-note sound logo on the first frame.

cta.on_screen: One line in the last 3 s that names the next episode.
cta.description: Sources and the calculation are in the description.
cta.pinned_comment: A question the video can answer in a follow-up.
avoid: asking for a follow before the payoff

language_variants: en-US spelling in titles; en-GB accepted in the video if the syllabus is British
